transcript.text: Hi everyone! I'm Nora. I understand Eli needs help exercising his dog during the first two weeks of September, and I'm open to working out a trade if the produce or goods make sense for me. Before I make my final decision, I'd like to do my usual arrangement check. Eli, could you start by stating the practical terms you're proposing — like the dates, times, and what you'd be offering in exchange? And Tess, I'd love to hear from you too about any care instructions for the dog. Then I'll make my call.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My proposal is six 45-minute walks from September 2 through September 13, in exchange for three produce boxes delivered to you on September 14, with no cash payment.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have an important care instruction for the dog's walks. I've seen the dog react badly to crowded dog-park paths, so for these walks the dog must use a front-clip harness and the side-street route, with no dog-park stop.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Nora will provide six 45-minute dog walks from September 2 through September 13.
Eli will deliver three produce boxes to Nora on September 14 as full payment, with no cash payment.
All walks must use a front-clip harness and the side-street route, with no dog-park stop.
